t: This is the Queen's Tower, a 287-foot tower topped with a copper-covered dome, standing on the South Kensington campus of Imperial College London. It was once the central tower of the Imperial Institute, and it is the only part of that building left. Climbing to the base of the dome takes 325 steps up narrow spiral staircases. Its architect was Thomas Collcutt, a Victorian who also designed the Savoy Hotel, Lloyd's Register of Shipping and the Palace Theatre.
